## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented change.

## Verification

- [ ] I ran the narrowest relevant tests.
- [ ] I ran broader checks required by `AGENTS.md` for shared or risky changes.
- [ ] I reviewed lifecycle cleanup for goroutines, timers, WebSockets, streams, and React effects.
- [ ] I reviewed authentication, RBAC, secrets, URLs, and YAML handling when applicable.
- [ ] I updated English and Chinese README/docs when user-facing behavior changed.
- [ ] I verified Helm, Docker, and release metadata when deployment behavior changed.

## Screenshots or Logs

passwords, tokens, kubeconfigs, API keys, or Kubernetes Secret values.
